findings.message: No JSON-LD block in the post.
'author' is not on the ficha dentist roster.

findings.evidence: Every adult finishes aligner treatment in six weeks.
findings.message: Statistic or study claim with no source link in the paragraph.
Internal link points to a page that is not in the ficha page list.

findings.quote: For mild cases, aligners work safely without a dental professional.
findings.why: This is dangerous and contradicts ADA/FDA guidance and the post's own advice that a licensed professional must assess and monitor aligner treatment.
findings.fix: Delete the sentence, or state that aligner treatment of any complexity should be planned and monitored by a licensed dental professional.

findings.quote: Every adult finishes aligner treatment in six weeks.
findings.why: This is a false, guaranteed treatment timeline; duration varies with each case and is typically many months.
findings.fix: Remove it, or say treatment length varies and the clinician can give an estimate after an evaluation.

findings.why: /services/clear-aligners is not among the pages listed in the ficha, so this internal link likely leads to a nonexistent page.
findings.fix: Link to an existing page such as /services or /team, or remove the link.

findings.why: Dr. Priya Shah is not a dentist listed in the ficha, so the authorship attribution is unverified and potentially fabricated.
findings.fix: Attribute the post to a dentist on the ficha (Dr. Marcus Oyelaran, who handles aligners) or to the clinic, if the author is not real staff.

findings.quote: It is possible to consider orthodontic treatment as an adult.
findings.why: The sentence is awkward and generic, a typical AI opening.
findings.fix: Rewrite it as, for example, 'Many adults consider orthodontic treatment, and age alone is rarely a barrier.'

findings.quote: Aligners are usually worn for most of the day, including while sleeping, and removed for meals and drinks other than water.
findings.why: This is consistent with general guidance on aligner wear, but the exact hours are not stated and the claim is not tied to a specific source.
findings.fix: Say that wear time is typically 20 to 22 hours a day if that is the clinician's instruction, or defer to the clinician's schedule, and cite the sources.

findings.quote: Dr. Marcus Oyelaran provides family and pediatric dentistry and clear aligners at Bluebonnet Hollow Dental.
findings.why: The statement matches the ficha, but the post gives no clinic phone, address or booking details for the call to action.
findings.fix: Add the phone number (512) 555-0142 and a link to /contact.
